    <title id="ae683f770-title">A solid black circle</title>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
Updated `0.html`. The page still shows a centered black circle, with these changes:

- **No stray scrollbars.** Replaced `width: 100vw` / `height: 100vh` with `min-height: 100dvh`, which avoids the horizontal scrollbar from `100vw` and handles mobile browser chrome correctly.
- **Responsive circle.** The SVG now sizes to the smaller of 400px or 80% of the viewport's shorter side, so it no longer overflows on small screens. `aspect-ratio` keeps it square.
- **Accessibility.** Added `role="img"` and a `<title>` so screen readers announce the graphic instead of skipping it or reading the raw id.
- **Explicit colors.** Set body background and text color, and the circle fills with `currentColor`, so recoloring is a one-line change.
- **Box-sizing reset** added to the universal selector for predictable layout if more content is added later.
